diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 3 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: AZ-Delivery 1.3 inch OLED I2C Display datasheet, Electrical characteristics table: 'Supply Voltage for Logic  VDD  External Supply  Min 3.0  Typ 3.3  Max 5.0  V' (absolute max 5.5 V). 3.3 V is the typical value, not the minimum; the module has an on-board 3.3 V regulator and 'can be connected to either 3.3V or 5V'. The model's vmin 3.0 / vmax 5.0 matches the vendor table.
